name: Supermemory
tagline: Memory API that gives any AI agent long-term recall.
description: Supermemory is a memory and context engine for AI apps. It ingests documents, chat histories, and connector data (Drive, Gmail, Notion), turns them into a searchable store, and serves relevant context back to agents over a single API. It works with any model and ships an MCP server alongside official SDKs.
insight: Built by 19-year-old Dhravya Shah; its $2.6M seed was backed by Google AI chief Jeff Dean and Cloudflare execs.

modelSupport.notes: Memory infrastructure; works with any LLM.

edge: MIT-licensed memory engine you self-host or call as a managed API — one recall endpoint across any model.
pros: Single recall API across any model
